user.title: Add Kestrel
user.description: Kestrel lets an Amazfit / Zepp OS watch control things you point at. After adding it, open Kestrel on the watch and choose Pair: Home Assistant will show a pairing code to enter on the watch. Each paired watch appears as a device; delete the device to unpair it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Kestrel is already set up. Pair more watches from the watch itself.

watch.title: {watch}
watch.description: What would you like to manage? Changes reach the watch the next time it syncs (Sync on the watch's home screen).

paints.title: Painted devices
paints.description: Remove a paint that went wrong, or make a paint trigger a different entity.

data_description.action: "Remove the newest spot" undoes the last paint of this device and keeps the others.

reassign.title: Trigger a different entity
reassign.description: The spots painted for {device} will trigger this entity instead.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Delete a room's Bluetooth calibration, for example after moving furniture or devices. Calibrate it again on the watch under More → Rooms.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Calibrating the gesture on the watch (More → Gesture) sets the thresholds; adjust them here if it triggers too easily (raise) or too hard (lower).

data_description.gesture_gyro: How fast the wrist must turn. Leave empty to not use the gyro.
data_description.gesture_jolt: How sharp a jolt the accelerometer must feel. Leave empty to not use it.
data_description.away_block: While the person below isn't home, the watch can only trigger the entities allowed while away. This keeps a pointing arm at work from switching things at home.
data_description.away_allowed: Entities that work wherever you are.
data_description.room_source: The watch's own Bluetooth room calibration, or a sensor whose state is an area name (for example from Bermuda).
data_description.room_sensor: A sensor whose state is the name of the area the watch (or you) is in.

abort.no_watches: No watches are paired yet. Open Kestrel on the watch and choose Pair with HA.
abort.no_paints: This watch hasn't painted any devices yet.
abort.no_rooms: This watch hasn't calibrated any rooms yet. Calibrate them on the watch under More → Rooms.

error.person_needed: Choose the person whose presence decides away mode.
error.sensor_needed: Choose the sensor that says which room you're in.

options.remove_last: Remove the newest spot (a bad paint)
